description: Agent-facing VFX recipe catalog (TICKET-0241/0243). Clone emitters via engine_asset_apply kind=particle; place stylized_flame.prefab.json for the hero look.

recipes.title: Wall torch layers
recipes.summary: Compact upright flame stack for sconces: disc core + molten flame + embers + smoke.
recipes.notes: Torch-scale molten look; keep glTF mesh materials (no whole-prop flame_core_emissive).

recipes.title: Campfire layer stack
recipes.summary: Stylized molten hearth: core + molten flame + sparks + smoke.
recipes.notes: Same stack as stylized_flame hero; do not paint flame_core_emissive on the whole mesh.

recipes.title: Hit spark burst
recipes.summary: Short bright sparks for weapon hits / impacts.
recipes.notes: Low lifetime, high spread, softLight; attach as brief rate pulse. Prefer sword_impact / arrow_impact / arcane_bolt_impact for play-test weapon contacts.

recipes.title: Ashfell sword impact
recipes.summary: Readable melee contact: additive white-amber flash + hot metal spark spray.
recipes.notes: Spawn via ParticleSystem::spawn_burst on hitFrame combat contacts; not a prefab attachment.

recipes.title: Dodge dust streak
recipes.summary: Short dusty motion streak at the feet when the player dodges.
recipes.notes: Spawn via ParticleSystem::spawn_burst opposite the dash direction; not a prefab attachment.

recipes.title: Footstep dust puff
recipes.summary: Subtle ground dust puff on walk/run strides and landings.
recipes.notes: Spawn via ParticleSystem::spawn_burst at feet from footstep animation events / stride counter; not a prefab attachment.

recipes.title: Bow arrow flight trail
recipes.summary: Faint cool-white wind-rush streaks (motion air, not magic sparks) along flying play-test arrows.
recipes.notes: Spawn via ParticleSystem::spawn_burst each few tenths of a meter while projectile flies; emissionDirection opposite flight; not a prefab attachment.

recipes.title: Bow arrow impact burst
recipes.summary: Gold flash + bright spark spray when a play-test arrow hits geometry, terrain, or a hurt volume.
recipes.notes: Spawn via ParticleSystem::spawn_burst on impact (footstep_dust companion puff on non-magic projectiles); not a prefab attachment.

recipes.title: Runecaster cast charge
recipes.summary: Cyan–gold sigil core + expanding rings at the focus tip, plus a ground swirl of runes under the caster's feet while charging MagicCast.
recipes.notes: Play-test bursts from castCharge until castRelease; keep burst rate low (spawn_burst allocates a full emitter pool). Atlas assets/vfx/rune_sigil_flipbook_4x4.png.

recipes.title: Runecaster arcane bolt
recipes.summary: Magenta helical bolt inspired by a hot pink-violet spiral projectile: additive core head, long violet streak wake, dark twist helix, shedding embers, bloom impact. Aims like bow.
recipes.notes: Spawn on castRelease from focus tip; denser distance-throttled trail + per-frame head flash in play-test. Impact uses magenta flash + sigil spray. Ref: context/art/concepts/arcane-bolt-spiral-inspiration.png

recipes.title: Runecaster fire bolt
recipes.summary: Orange fireball: fire-flipbook core and trail, smoke helix, rising embers, bloom impact. Held tag magic_fire.

recipes.title: Runecaster frost bolt
recipes.summary: Ice-blue shard: rune core, cool wind trail, mist helix, falling crystals, frost impact. Held tag magic_frost.

recipes.title: Runecaster lightning bolt
recipes.summary: White-gold crack: additive core, long jagged streaks, bright flash impact. Held tag magic_lightning.

recipes.title: Corrupt aura
recipes.summary: Slow violet-green haze for cursed props or blight zones.
recipes.notes: Low lightEmission; pair with emissive_magic materials if needed.

recipes.title: Stylized flame — molten (trio)
recipes.summary: Blobby crossed-billboard flame + sparks + smoke. Hero prefab: assets/prefabs/Scene Assets/stylized_flame.prefab.json
recipes.notes: Matches particle-trio molten look; bright core is flipbook particles + point light (not whole-mesh emissive).

recipes.title: Stylized flame — wispy ribbon
recipes.summary: Narrow, high-spread ribbons for wind-blown fire.
recipes.notes: Swap molten emitter on stylized_flame prefab for this look.

recipes.title: Stylized flame — diffuse column
recipes.summary: Tall tight cylinder emission for pillar fire.
recipes.notes: Low spreadAngle + cylinder shapeSize.y for height.
